name: bk_exp08_matched_dose
title: At an equal push, both readers follow language and the NLA follows tense, but neither follows line position
caption: Pilot (excluded from main analysis), layer 42, 60 items per feature. Each item's activation is pushed along the feature's raw class-mean (or regression) direction by +/-0.11 of its own norm (centred), and the reader scores fixed label phrasings; AUROC separates the + from the - version (0.5 = no response). Error bars: 95% item bootstrap (2,000). Grey box: range of AUROCs for 20 random J-complement directions pushed the same way. At 0.14 of the norm the picture is the same (NLA 0.92 / 0.89 / 0.47). Caveat: fixed templates; the line-position direction is a regression direction, the others class-mean differences.

notes: Primary template families: lang/tense 'label' (3 pairs each, e.g. NLA 'The text is written in Russian' vs '... in Polish'; 'The verb is in the past tense' vs '... present tense'; Oracle Lens '- Russian language', '- was' vs '- is'); col 'count_qual' ('near the end of a long line' vs 'at the start of a line'; 'a long line' vs 'a short line'). Scores are template-family mean log-odds, loaded with calib_analyze.load/scores (read-only import). Language here is 02's Russian-Polish direction, not French/German. Null band = 20 J-complement (4r*) unit directions at the same per-item norms. r14 values: {"NLA lang": 0.922, "Oracle Lens lang": 0.847, "NLA tense": 0.888, "Oracle Lens tense": 0.569, "NLA col": 0.475, "Oracle Lens col": 0.472}
